stem: The bar graph shows the number of books borrowed from a school library on each of four days. What percent of the books borrowed over the four days were borrowed on Tuesday?

figure.title: Books borrowed from a school library

solution: Read the graph and add: \(36 + 54 + 42 + 48 = 180\) books.

explanation.A: Correct. 54 of the 180 books were borrowed on Tuesday, and \(\frac{54}{180} = 30\%\).
explanation.B: Incorrect. This treats the 54 books borrowed on Tuesday as a percent instead of comparing them with the total.
explanation.C: Incorrect. This is Tuesday's number as a percent of Monday's number, \(\frac{54}{36} = 150\%\).
explanation.D: Incorrect. This compares Tuesday with the other three days only, \(\frac{54}{126} \approx 42.9\%\), instead of with all 180 books.

verify:
choices = {o: choices[n] for o, n in {'A': 'A', 'C': 'B', 'D': 'C', 'B': 'D'}.items()}; answer = {'A': 'A', 'B': 'C', 'C': 'D', 'D': 'B'}[answer]  # shuffled: original letters
pts = dict(figure['series'][0]['points'])
v = Rational(pts['Tuesday'], sum(pts.values()))
assert v == Rational(3, 10)
assert value(choices[answer]) == v
assert all(value(choices[k]) != v for k in choices if k != answer)
